own_body.title: 4.1 . Zones configurator
own_body.summary: The section describes the default settings for the zones configurator, including parameters for default zone distances, Hector server addresses, and zones mapping file versions. It explains that the zones.json file is saved in the Qursor Configurator application, where changes can be saved as new versions and applied from a list. Additionally, it notes that the info section displays who created and applied a specific file and when.

children.title: Further each zone can be defined with a following set of attributes:
children.summary: The section lists the specific attributes required to define a zone, including name, ID, server address, type, subtype, and stop parameters. It also describes the use of a visual editor to draw and modify zone polygons on a map.
